subject: Hosted API: flexible commit proposal and competitive price-match request
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@horizon.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API: flexible commit proposal and competitive price-match request

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for the quick intro this morning. Per our conversation, I've put together an initial outline for a flexible commit structure for Horizon's LLM usage on Redwood Hosted API. High level:

- Goal: match unit economics you have from other providers for committed traffic while keeping Redwood's performance and SLA guarantees.
- Proposal: three-tier commit window (Q1 ramp, steady-state monthly commit, overage cap) with blended per-token pricing that improves with committed volume.
- Optional: first 90 days introductory match to your incumbent per-token rate (subject to minimum commit and non-resale clause).

I've attached a short proposal (redwood-commit-starting-proposal.pdf) with sample tiers and a rough competitive comparison vs. the rates you mentioned for OpenAI/Anthropic.

Can we schedule a 30-min call later this week to walk the numbers and procurement requirements? If you can share the procurement contact, I can loop them in and pre-share a counteroffer.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood-commit-starting-proposal.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)
From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@horizon.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@horizon.ai>, Horizon Analytics Procurement <procurement@horizon.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 13:40:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API: flexible commit proposal and competitive price-match request

Jonas,

Appreciate the proposal. A few clarifying points from procurement before we jump on a call:

1) Can Redwood formally match the per-token published rate we have from our current vendor (we prefer not to name them in email, but we can share the invoice details on the call)?
2) Do you allow smoothing of commits over a quarter (we spike intermittently)?
3) SOC 2 Type II and logging/audit evidence are required by our security team.
4) What is the minimum commit to qualify for price-match? We need a written guarantee that the matched rate will apply to committed usage and any covered overage tiers.

I'm attaching our RFP summary and the procurement checklist so you can reference the clauses we care about.

Best,
Samantha Liu
Director of AI Products
Horizon Analytics
samantha.liu@horizon.ai

Attachment: Horizon_RFP_2026.pdf (DOCX, 7 pages)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@horizon.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 06 May 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API: flexible commit proposal and competitive price-match request

Thanks, Samantha — great questions. Quick answers up front, then a revised proposal attached.

- Price-match: we can offer a conditional price-match for committed monthly volume against a named competitor invoice for the same time period. This match applies to the committed bucket only and excludes marketplace/platform fees.
- Smoothing: we support quarter-level smoothing; committed volumes can be averaged over a 90-day window with a carry-forward/true-up mechanism at quarter end.
- Compliance: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II; I can share our AICPA report and a short control summary during the procurement review.
- Minimum: baseline minimum commit to qualify is $50k/mo in committed usage (we can tier below for pilot programs, see attached).

I've attached an updated proposal (horizon-proposal-v2.pdf) that shows three commit bands and sample blended per-token rates, plus a short competitive comparison vs. the incumbent rates you referenced. Highlights:

- Pilot band (month 1-3): aggressive intro match up to 100M tokens/month with 30% discount off list for committed units.
- Steady-state band (post-pilot): tiered per-token pricing starting at $0.0009/token for 100M-500M, $0.0007/token for 500M-2B, with additional discounts at multi-quarter commits.
- Overages: capped at 120% of the blended committed rate; administrative true-up quarterly.

Can we lock a 30-min slot Thursday 10am PT? I'll bring Ben from Pricing to run through the numbers.

Best,
Jonas

Attachment: horizon-proposal-v2.pdf (PDF, 4 pages)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 08 May 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Horizon proposal — internal pricing approval request

Rishi / Jon,

Following the call with Horizon yesterday, they pushed hard on matching their incumbent rate for the pilot and want more favorable overage caps. They're a strategic early customer in the analytics space; displacement would be valuable.

Requesting one-time concession: grant a 25% below-list match on committed units for the first 90 days (pilot) provided:
- Minimum pilot commit of $20k/month (3 months)
- No resale/resale-clause (Horizon must be end-customer)
- Auto-conversion to the steady-state tier unless they explicitly opt out prior to quarter end

If approved, I'll send the commercial counteroffer and push docu-sign.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 09 May 2026 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Horizon proposal — internal pricing approval request

Ben / Jon — approved with conditions.

Conditions:
- Approve the 25% pilot concession for first 90 days on committed units, with minimum $20k/mo pilot commit and no resale.
- Require a 12-month minimum term for the steady-state pricing to be eligible for deeper multi-quarter discounts (we'll include an early-termination fee to protect economics).
- Add a documented competitive-price-match clause that requires Horizon to provide competitor invoices for the matched window; discounts are revocable if reseller/aggregator activity is discovered.
- Legal to review T&Cs and procurement addendum; procurement must sign acceptance before pricing is locked.

Jon — please draft the counteroffer and route to Legal & Procurement. Ben — you can go ahead and prepare the commercial for signature once Legal confirms the addendum language.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@horizon.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Final counteroffer and next steps (DocuSign link enclosed)

Samantha — thanks for your patience. Attached is the counteroffer reflecting the pilot price-match and the committed tiers we discussed. Summary of agreed commercial points: 

- Pilot (Months 1-3): Horizon pilot commit $20k/mo minimum. Redwood will match the incumbent per-token rate up to 100M tokens/month for the pilot period; effective pilot discount ~25% off list for the committed units.
- Smoothing: Quarter-level smoothing with carry-forward true-up and quarterly reconciliation.
- Steady-state: 12-month minimum term after pilot to qualify for deeper multi-quarter discounts; tiered per-token pricing applies thereafter.
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II evidence and crosswalk to procurement checklist included in the procurement packet.
- Conditions: Price-match contingent on competitor invoice(s) for the matched window and no resale. Discounts are revocable if reseller behavior is found.

Next steps:
1) Review attached counteroffer (Horizon_Counteroffer_Redwood_20260512.pdf).
2) Sign via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abc123-horizon-redwood.
3) Legal & Procurement will complete the addendum; Redwood will provide SOC 2 report and logging export sample.

If you want to jump on a 15-min call to finalize, I'm free tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: Horizon_Counteroffer_Redwood_20260512.pdf (PDF, 6 pages)
